about: Official English Blue Archive voice-line text, a supplement to Azur Archive's own MomoTalk lines. Each line joins one deck slot (who:slot) while gameArt is on. 'Sensei' is written {S} so addressAs applies; line breaks in the source are rendered as a space. Text (c) NEXON Games & Yostar; English transcription from bluearchive.wiki, CC BY-SA 4.0. One CREDITS.md row per line.

lines.text: I have approximately 34 tips on how to improve your behavior, {S}.
...Crime? What do you mean? Wiretapping is not a crime.
Nihaha, {S}! ...Huh? No, I didn't touch anything. Maybe...?
Do I need a break? I've been taking enough breaks, thanks to you.
Rest? Nope, I'm good to go! Let's play together instead!
Oh, don't mind me. I'm just...observing.
Understood. You don't have much to do right now. You're bored.
{S}, I told you to lock your computer before leaving.
Take care of your health too. It's gotta take priority!
Heehee, aren't you a bit late, {S}?
